pairs: Of David, with the inscription of a title.
If, truly and certainly, you speak justice,
For, even in your heart, you work iniquity.
in terra injustitias manus vestræ concinnant.
Your hands construct injustice on the earth.
Sinners have become foreigners from the womb;
they have gone astray from conception.
Their fury is similar to that of a serpent;
it is like a deaf asp,
who will not listen to the voice of charmers,
nor even to the enchanter who chants wisely.
Deus conteret dentes eorum in ore ipsorum;
God will crush their teeth within their own mouth.
The Lord will break the molars of the lions.
Ad nihilum devenient tamquam aqua decurrens;
They will come to nothing, like water flowing away.
He has aimed his bow, while they are being weakened.
Like wax that flows, they will be carried away.
and they will not see the sun.
Before your thorns could know the brier,
sicut viventes sic in ira absorbet eos.
he consumes them alive, as if in rage.
The just one will rejoice when he sees vindication.
manus suas lavabit in sanguine peccatoris.
He will wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.
“If the just one is fruitful, then,
utique est Deus judicans eos in terra.
truly, there is a God judging them on earth.”
